meta_data.base_class: retrieve artists exhibited in museums of a specific <country> during a given period - museum systems across countries are independent but share the same query structure.

tool_template.name: get_<class>_museum_artists
tool_template.description: Retrieves a list of all artists whose works are present in a museum of <class> during a particular period.

museum_name.description: The name of the museum in <class>.

period.description: The time period for which to retrieve the artists, e.g., 19th Century.

artist_nationality.description: The nationality of the artists to filter the list.

art_style.description: The art style to filter the artists by, e.g., 'Impressionism', for the given museum in <class>.

exhibition_type.description: The type of exhibition to focus on, such as 'permanent' or 'temporary', for the given museum in <class>.

max_results.description: The maximum number of artists to retrieve from the the given museum in <class>.
